title: ynf lanes
description: Lane policy for ynf: when to run, with which runner, and what to do with each outcome. Found at .agents/factory/lanes.yaml (or a fallback, ADR-009). See ADR-006.

defaults.description: Values every lane in this file inherits unless it sets its own.

lanes.description: Lanes by name. A target repository's lane with the same name as a config repository's lane overrides it key by key.

host.description: A hostname, optionally with a leading wildcard label.

template.description: A command with placeholders filled from structured facts only. {label.<prefix>} is the value of the item's '<prefix>:<value>' label; values must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$ or the run is not started.

executor.description: How the runner is contained. 'process' is accepted only for interactive steps and shadow mode (ADR-007).

attempts.description: Claims of one step before the item is quarantined (ADR-005).

id.description: The lane's own id for telemetry, which stays fixed if the repository that defines it moves. Without one the id is where the lane is defined, host first, then its name: github.com/acme/factory-config#lint-paydown (ADR-006).

kind.description: originate: ynf creates the branch and pull request. adopt: ynf works on a pull request someone else opened (ADR-002).

guards.description: CEL expressions over structured facts. Free text is not in the CEL environment (ADR-006).

github.search.description: A GitHub search query for issues or pull requests.

url.description: sqs://, sns://, nats://, pubsub://, kafka:// or eventbridge:// URL.

types.description: ynf event types to accept from the topic.

runner.description: Omit to let ynf choose (ADR-012): ynh when the lane has a ynh block and ynh is detected on the host, else its command block. A lane that omits it needs a ynh block, a command block or both. Naming a runner the host cannot provide fails the lane; it never falls back.

image.description: The container image a docker, ecs or k8s-job executor runs the runner in, pinned by tag or digest. The ynh runner builds its own with `ynh image` when this is omitted. For the command runner, command.image wins when set.

env.description: Names of variables passed from ynf's environment into the run, such as the model provider's key. Values are never logged or recorded. Nothing else from ynf's environment reaches a contained run.

harness.description: A path to a harness folder in the repository ('.' for its own .agents/harness), from which ynf builds the run's image with `ynh image --entrypoint agent` when the lane names no published image. With run.image it is optional: the image carries its harness, and this picks one by id or name when it carries several.

model.description: ynh's --model: the model the agent runs on, as the vendor names it (for the claude vendor, an alias such as sonnet or a full name such as claude-sonnet-5-5). Letters, digits and . - _ / :, not starting with a dash. Omit it for the vendor's default.

effort.description: ynh's --effort: the reasoning effort the agent is asked to run at. ynh maps it to each vendor's own setting (claude's --effort, codex's model_reasoning_effort) and refuses it, before the run starts, for a vendor with no effort control (cursor). Omit it for the harness's agent.effort, else the vendor's default. Needs ynh 0.10.0 or later. The run records the effort asked for and the effort the backend reported.

auto_approve.description: ynh's --auto-approve: the worker runs without approval prompts, for file edits only or for everything. Passed only to a run inside containment (the docker executor), and only to an agent image whose ynh supports it: ynh 0.9.0 or later (capabilities 0.9.0). Use the narrowest that works.

budgets.description: May only tighten the harness's own budgets (ADR-006).

sensor_scope.description: Narrow a sensor the harness declares to the item, through ynh's --sensor-overlay, which substitutes the command. A scope may only be the declared command narrowed: the same words in the same order, except that a path word (`.`, `./...`, a directory) may be replaced by one or more relative paths beneath it (no `..`, no leading dash), or, when the declared command has no path word, relative paths may be appended. A different program, flag or environment assignment, or any shell operator or expansion, is refused before the run. Cannot add, remove or relax a sensor.

vendor.description: The vendor the harness runs. Its API host is allowed through the egress proxy without being listed (ADR-007). Default: the harness's default_vendor, treated as claude for egress.

base.description: The base image `ynh image --base` builds the harness image on, for lanes whose sensors need tools the default ynh image lacks.

telemetry_relay.description: Turn on ynh's telemetry relay for this lane's runs, by setting YNH_TELEMETRY_RELAY=1: ynh agent run starts ynr relay beside the vendor CLI, which exports only over the network, and the relay writes what it receives into the run's own spool folder (ynr ADR-004). It needs a spool root in ynf's configuration, ynr in the run's image or on its PATH, and a lane that runs ynh: a lane that runs the command runner refuses it. Default false.

argv.description: Run without a shell. Exit 0 is 'converged', anything else 'error', unless result_file says more.

image.description: The container image the command runner runs in on a docker, ecs or k8s-job executor, pinned by tag or digest. When the lane resolves to the command runner it wins over run.image; when it resolves to ynh it is ignored, so a lane with both blocks can name each one's image.

image_user.description: Keep the image's own user and home on a docker executor, as a ynh-built agent image does, instead of running as ynf's user. Default false. ynf names that user in the run's spool manifest so ynr serve reads what it writes there.

result_file.description: Where the command writes a ynf RunResult, if it does.

allow.description: Hosts a run may reach besides the model provider. Everything else is denied and logged (ADR-007).

when.description: Named 'when', not 'on', because YAML 1.1 parsers read a bare on as the boolean true. What to do for each outcome and external fact. Outcomes are ynf's vocabulary (ADR-012), never a runner's exit codes.

allowed_paths.description: The diff gate refuses a change outside these paths (ADR-007). Protected paths are refused regardless.

protected_paths.description: Paths the diff gate refuses in addition to ynf's built-in protected paths (CI workflows, CODEOWNERS, .agents/, .ynh/, .ynm/, .ynf/), for example a linter's configuration.

stop.description: Stop conditions that pause the lane (ADR-010).

remove.description: Labels to remove; one already absent is fine.

labels.description: Labels ynf writes on the ticket as the item moves, through its tracker (ADR-003). Each is applied when the item enters the state, never blocks a step, and is logged.

on_claim.description: ynf takes the item on: from intake to ready. Remove the label that triggered it here, so no search or rule fires again.

on_propose.description: A pull request is open, waiting on CI.

on_review.description: CI is green: waiting on a human.

on_escalate.description: Escalated or quarantined: a human must decide.
